scripts.start:bg: nest build && mkdir -p ../../logs && nohup node dist/main >> ../../logs/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > ../../.server.pid && echo "Server started (PID: $(cat ../../.server.pid)), log: logs/server.log"
scripts.stop: if [ -f ../../.server.pid ] && kill -0 $(cat ../../.server.pid) 2>/dev/null; then kill $(cat ../../.server.pid) && rm -f ../../.server.pid && echo 'Server stopped'; else rm -f ../../.server.pid && echo 'Server not running'; fi
